g.text: Sub-agents — boxes Kratos reaches through a small agent (telemetry + investigations)
◐ Listening inside this Kratos window: telemetry STOPS when you quit. Press L to keep it running always.
Installs a small agent on the box that dials OUT to Kratos, streams telemetry and answers investigations
with its own built-in reads only. No inbound port on your box. Approved fixes are opt-in and OFF by
Listener is running inside Kratos for now (this session). For always-on monitoring after you close Kratos,
press 'L' to install it as a service.
How should Kratos read 203.0.113.159 through db-01?
Through the sub-agent, Kratos reads logs, processes, open files, config and
file hashes and runs YARA with the box's own rules — the agent runs only its
built-in reads. Network scans (open ports, vulnerabilities) need a direct path
from Kratos, so they're skipped for a sub-agent-only box and the answer says
Through the sub-agent only — this box has no SSH from Kratos
SSH first, sub-agent if SSH can't connect — both are set up
✓ db-01 paired (db-01, agent 0.3.1) -- telemetry is live. It is recommend-only; turn on direct execution
from /whitelist only if you want it.
